results.name: aksMaintenanceNodeConf
results.reason: Learn lists 2026-08-01 as the latest stable GA, newer than current 2026-07-01; 2026-08-02-preview is not GA. Exact current and candidate schemas both require schedule, durationHours, and startTime inside maintenanceWindow; the weekly schedule requires dayOfWeek and intervalWeeks. The supplied values satisfy all numeric, enum, date, and pattern constraints, and the exact operation allows the literal configuration name.
results.migration: Compatible with latest GA 2026-08-01; check-only identifies an update candidate but makes no source changes.

findings.detail: Current 2026-07-01; latest GA 2026-08-01. Exact current and candidate schemas support the same used maintenanceWindow fields and literals. The 2026-08-01 change log removes maintenanceWindowId, which this declaration does not use; preview 2026-08-02-preview is not treated as GA.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: body:10: Bicep source JSON Pointer /parent (expression 'parent: aksCluster'); Bicep parent aksCluster supplies the managedClusters resourceName route segment and establishes child-resource scope; it is not part of the REST body.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: body:29: Bicep source JSON Pointer /name (expression "name: 'aksManagedNodeOSUpgradeSchedule'"); The child name maps to the required configName path parameter, whose exact operation description allows only default, aksManagedAutoUpgradeSchedule, or aksManagedNodeOSUpgradeSchedule; the supplied literal is allowed.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: body:77: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties (expression 'properties: {'); Maps to the MaintenanceConfiguration body properties object; it supplies maintenanceWindow, whose nested schedule, durationHours, and startTime are required by the exact schema.

usage.label: maintenanceWindow
usage.analysis: body:102: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow (expression 'maintenanceWindow: {'); Maps to MaintenanceConfigurationProperties.maintenanceWindow; the object includes all required fields schedule, durationHours, and startTime.

usage.label: durationHours
usage.analysis: body:125: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/durationHours (expression 'durationHours: 4'); Maps to required MaintenanceWindow.durationHours, integer range 4–24; literal 4 is valid.

usage.label: schedule
usage.analysis: body:143: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/schedule (expression 'schedule: {'); Maps to required MaintenanceWindow.schedule; the weekly recurrence variant is supplied.

usage.label: weekly
usage.analysis: body:161: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/schedule/weekly (expression 'weekly: {'); Maps to Schedule.weekly; both required fields dayOfWeek and intervalWeeks are supplied.

usage.label: dayOfWeek
usage.analysis: body:184: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/schedule/weekly/dayOfWeek (expression "dayOfWeek: 'Wednesday'"); Maps to required WeeklySchedule.dayOfWeek; 'Wednesday' is an exact allowed weekday enum value.

usage.label: intervalWeeks
usage.analysis: body:221: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/schedule/weekly/intervalWeeks (expression 'intervalWeeks: 1'); Maps to required WeeklySchedule.intervalWeeks, integer range 1–4; literal 1 is valid.

usage.label: startDate
usage.analysis: body:258: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/startDate (expression "startDate: '2025-04-01'"); Maps to optional MaintenanceWindow.startDate with date format; '2025-04-01' is a valid ISO date. The exact candidate schema retains this field.

usage.label: startTime
usage.analysis: body:288: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/startTime (expression "startTime: '00:00'"); Maps to required MaintenanceWindow.startTime with pattern ^\d{2}:\d{2}$ and documented range 00:00–23:59; '00:00' is valid.

usage.label: utcOffset
usage.analysis: body:313: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/maintenanceWindow/utcOffset (expression "utcOffset: '+09:00'"); Maps to optional MaintenanceWindow.utcOffset with pattern ^(-|\+)[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$; '+09:00' is valid.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: header:line:0: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 (expression "resource aksMaintenanceNodeConf 'Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/maintenanceConfigurations@2026-07-01' ="); Bicep declaration header identifies the current API version; it is not a request-body attribute.

current.analysis: Learn current-version page and pinned stable 2026-07-01 managedClusters.json confirm current contract. Schemas helper expanded MaintenanceConfiguration, MaintenanceWindow and Schedule/WeeklySchedule. Required schedule/durationHours/startTime and weekly dayOfWeek/intervalWeeks are present; exact bounds, enum, format and patterns match source. The PUT operation confirms the supported configName values.

ga.analysis: Learn version selector lists 2026-08-01 as latest stable GA and 2026-08-02-preview as newer preview. Pinned README maps stable and preview tags to their exact files. Exact candidate stable schema was checked against the current schema; every used property and constraint matches.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log reports that 2026-08-01 removes MaintenanceConfigurationProperties.maintenanceWindowId. Neither current 2026-07-01 nor candidate 2026-08-01 exact schema includes that field, and this source does not use it. The used maintenanceWindow and nested schedule fields remain present with identical constraints in both specs.
